scope: Matched complete-request screens with speculation and the spinner on: admission repair, cache-prior bonus, lenience, draft width and confidence, and DRAM backing. Each arm can change routing, acceptance or both, and therefore output, so usability decides selection after speed.

repair_basis.service_saved_ms: Mean of what one fewer CPU job and one fewer copy save per pass on the spinner training passes under the unqualified grouped model, 0.29-0.37 ms, against an effective 0.58 ms today.
repair_basis.interference_ms: What an exchange costs beyond the charged 0.595 H2D + 0.594 D2H, under the same model: prefix 0.752 + tail 0.084 + two pending joins at 0.251 = 1.337 ms.
repair_basis.screen: The unqualified fixed-demand screen predicts a tie or a small loss for every price tried. The arm is here because the plan requires the repair to be tested on hardware, not because the screen recommends it.

standalone.note: Adopted from the resident engine of speculative-20261107.

backing.note: 24 requests and 8 backing changes. The engine refuses before allocating if 13.9 GB plus its 16 GiB reserve do not fit; a refusal ends the phase and is reported as untested.

planned_executions.note: Hard limit. The driver has no path to an undeclared run.

stopping.rule: All requests of a screen, evaluated once by tools/mm3/native_arm_screen.py. An arm qualifies at -2% or better with a 95% interval excluding zero and neither prompt slower. No value that changes output is selected without passing the bounded usability checks; one that fails is rejected and the next qualifying value, if any, is checked once. Qualifying backing arms also weigh 13.9 GB of DRAM and need the reserve to hold. Qualifying values from different screens are verified together in the final comparison, not assumed additive.
